buyer_question: Can you answer the vendor security questionnaire by the buyer deadline?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Questionnaire topic list, due date, approved answer source category, freshness date; no customer names or confidential questionnaire files
safe_follow_up_when: Owner confirms source category and buyer-safe response status
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim security compliance, certification, faster approval, win rate, revenue, pipeline, ROI or customer outcome impact

buyer_question: Which requested trust artifacts are approved to share?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted artifact register: SOC 2/ISO/HITRUST status category, pen test status category, subprocessor link category, incident-response policy category
safe_follow_up_when: Artifact owner marks shareable, gap, needs legal/security review or unavailable
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not expose raw security reports, confidential findings, prospect names, deal IDs, access logs, passwords, tokens or secrets

buyer_question: What legal or privacy clause is delaying the next step?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Clause topic category, responsible owner, review status, safe public summary, required escalation; no contract file by default
safe_follow_up_when: Qualified owner approves next action or confirms pending review
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not give legal, privacy, compliance or procurement advice and do not promise contract acceptance

buyer_question: How does the product or team use AI?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Product AI feature boundary, internal AI tool boundary, training-use statement category, human-review notes, retention/source category
safe_follow_up_when: Product/security/legal owners confirm answer source and unsafe claim stop list
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim AI accuracy, safety, non-use of data, model behavior, compliance or customer outcomes without verified approved evidence

buyer_question: Where is data processed and who are subprocessors?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Published subprocessor link category, region/residency statement category, data-flow owner, cross-border review owner
safe_follow_up_when: Owner confirms current approved source and buyer-safe wording
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim GDPR, EU AI Act, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO or residency compliance unless formally verified and approved

buyer_question: Who owns the next buyer-facing action?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: AE/SE/security/legal/founder/deal-desk owner, blocker age, next action, deadline and escalation path
safe_follow_up_when: Next owner and response deadline are confirmed
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim sales-cycle improvement, deal acceleration, close probability, conversion lift, customer proof or pipeline value

buyer_question: What evidence is missing or stale?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Gap category, owner, target update date, approved substitute answer category and risk note
safe_follow_up_when: Gap owner confirms safe interim answer or hold status
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not publish gaps as proof, certification, compliance, benchmark or customer assurance

buyer_question: Is pricing or spend approval blocking procurement?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Exception type, approval owner, date needed, response owner and non-confidential summary
safe_follow_up_when: Finance/deal owner confirms approved response path
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not expose discounts, contract values, revenue exports, invoices, forecasts or commercial terms by default

buyer_question: Is the buyer asking for logos, testimonials or case studies?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Approved public proof link category, reference policy, claim approval owner and no-proof fallback wording
safe_follow_up_when: Approved public proof exists or owner approves a no-proof response
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not invent customers, testimonials, rankings, revenue, analytics, logos, savings, outcomes or reference availability

buyer_question: What should not be collected for the first review?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: No credentials, secrets, regulated data, customer identifiers, CRM exports, raw contracts, raw security reports, production logs or confidential files by default
safe_follow_up_when: Buyer agrees to redacted fields and qualified-owner review boundaries
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not request or store passwords tokens secrets PHI PII contracts revenue exports CRM exports or raw security reports by default
